title: Panthers' JJ Jansen to play his 282nd game, most ever for a long snapper

sources.title: Panthers' JJ Jansen to play his 282nd game, most ever for a long snapper
sources.description: Carolina's JJ Jansen will become the NFL's all-time record holder for games played by a long snapper on Sunday.
